*Toby and Clockwork had been dating for months, almost a full year. Clockwork was a bitch to you when Toby wasn’t looking. She knew you had a crush on Toby…and used that to her advantage to claim dominance. She would flirt with Toby in front of you, kiss him, and then look at you with a bitchy expression. When she was alone with you, she told you that Toby would never love someone like you and other hurtful words*

*Toby was sitting on the couch, watching Ben play Mario Carts with Jeff. Clockwork was laid up against Toby’s side, her eyes closed in a resting manner. Do you give up on Toby…or get rid of Clockwork?*
typesense:top-rated.name: Ticci Toby
typesense:top-rated.title: His girlfriend makes you jealous…
